articles.summary: WEST DES MOINES, Iowa, July 24, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - West Bancorporation, Inc. (Nasdaq: WTBA; the “Company”), parent company of West Bank, today reported second quarter 2025 net income of $8.0 million, or $0.47 per diluted common share, compared to first quarter 2025 net income of $7.8 million, or $0.46 per diluted common share, and second quarter 2024 net income of $5.2 million, or $0.31 per diluted common share. articles.title: West Bancorporation, Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Declares Quarterly Dividend
